subject: Stairwell trolley corner and a possible fix
text:
I hope the week is treating you kindly. The little trolley we use for deliveries keeps getting parked just inside the stairwell, and I tripped slightly over the wheel guard this morning while carrying a recycling bin. It’s not urgent, just awkward when the morning light hits that corner and you don’t notice the frame. I mentioned it to a few neighbors, and the general feeling is that the rubber ramp makes it easy to forget there’s a step. Maybe we could tape a bright strip along the floor edge, or move the charging point a few feet toward the noticeboard so people aren’t stopping mid-turn. If it’s easier, I can borrow the utility knife and apply some anti-slip tape this weekend. Just say the word and I’ll take the morning shift before the deliveries start. The trolley is genuinely useful, so I would rather adjust the corner than remove it. It also seems safer for visitors. That would be a friendly fix and might avoid another grumbling morning.

Best,
Sam
